verdict: Organic activity is slowing with no paid channel to offset the dip.
narrative: This period, your only active channel was your Google Business Profile, which drove 97 total actions — 21 calls, 30 direction requests, and 46 website clicks — with no paid advertising running on Meta or Google. GBP activity fell 22% week-over-week, and Instagram reach dropped 29% over the same stretch, both confirmed by the last several days of data rather than a single outlier. With no paid spend in place, there is no lever to compensate when organic visibility softens. Reactivating paid campaigns is the direct path to creating a stable, controllable lead flow, and that conversation is the priority heading into the next period.

watch_item.issue: Both GBP actions and Instagram reach are trending down week-over-week with no paid activity running to compensate.
